question: Which of the following is a non-conventional source of energy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wind**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Energy **is one of the major parts of the **economic infrastructure, being the basic input needed to sustain economic growth.**
 
• There exists a strong relationship between economic development and energy consumption.
 
• The more developed a country is,** the higher the per capita of energy consumption and vice-versa.**
 
• Human civilization relies on different sources of energy.

**Source of Non - conventional energy**

 [IMAGE: https://images.ctfassets.net/0fol1oltsp9p/H4EkKlug0NpKkKED5fy3s/1ba87f1dcadfd61bf672fc537fb95957/Types_of_Renewable_Energy.jpg?w=920] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wood:**
 
• Wood forms the source of energy for a lot of people still living in** rural** areas.
 
• It has a low **calorific** value and cannot be used for industrial processes.
 
• **Crop Residue:**
 
• Crop residue is used as an energy source on **farms**.
 
• They have the least **calorific** value and are not found in abundant quantities.
 
• **​Petrol:**
 
• Petrol is obtained from **petroleum**.
 
• products of petroleum are known as** black gold**.
 
• The caloric value of petrol is** 45000 KJ/kg** Where K = **Kelvin, **J** = Joule and** Kg** = Kilogram.**
 
• **Coal:**
 
• Coal is a **sedimentary** black or dark brown rock that varies in composition.
 
• Some types of coal burn hotter and cleaner, while others contain high **moisture **content.
 
• It contains compounds that contribute to **acid rain** and other pollution when burned.
 
• Used in **industrial** processes.
